corrections.reason: In John 11:8, the plural subject አይሁድ takes the 3rd person plural verb የኃሥሡ (with the ka'eb vowel mark clearly visible on the bottom right of ሡ in the image).
The word wrapping onto line 34 (ንደ ፀሐይ) is እንደ ('like the sun'), and the glyph at the end of line 33 is 6th-order እ.
The glyph has the 2nd-order (ካዕብ) hook at the bottom of the right leg (ሉ), forming አይጣሉኝም ('they will not cast me down'), parallel to ይጣሉኛል on line 15.
The patristic citation reads ወአሕጸረ ዕድሜ ለርእሱ እንዲል ('and He shortened the time/span for Himself'); the initial triangular glyph is ዕ, not ሰ.
The initial character on line 26 is እ (እርሳቸው ግን ... መስሏቸው ነበር), misread as ለ.
